attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding menologion day (30 September 2026). saint.gr puts him at Pskov, so that calendar is the one most likely to hold him, and it was not read.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 4ης Μαρτίου — «Άγιοι Βασίλειος του Μιρώζ και Ιωάσαφ του Σνετνογκόρσκ οι Οσιομάρτυρες»

attestations.note: One page holds the two of them and heads each «(; - 1299)». Its whole notice is three sentences: they lived in the thirteenth century in the region of Pskov in Russia; Basil was abbot of the monastery of the Transfiguration of the Saviour of Mirozh and Joasaph abbot of the monastery of the Nativity of the Theotokos of Mount Snatna; and they were martyred in the year 1299, when the Germans attacked Pskov and the monasteries of the region. Because the line names both, each is kept as a folder of his own. The page gives no place of birth, no year for it, no manner of death, no relic, no distich and no hymn.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding menologion day (30 September 2026).

death.note: saint.gr: «Οι Άγιοι μαρτύρησαν κατά το έτος 1299 μ.Χ., όταν οι Γερμανοί επιτέθηκαν εναντίων του Πσκωφ και των μοναστηριών της περιοχής», and the page heads him «(; - 1299)». It gives no year of birth, only the thirteenth century for the two of them.
